visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and red hairpins stands on a red athletic track wearing a maroon and white Rakuten cheerleader outfit. She holds two large, crinkled transparent plastic bags, waving them energetically while smiling and winking at the camera. The background shows empty blue stadium seats and a few equipment setups under natural daylight. (2) A man in a grey sweatshirt and a light blue cap stands outdoors in front of a modern glass-walled building. He attempts a coordinated movement challenge with two plastic bags, circling his hands with a focused expression. (3) Indoors, a young woman in a striped white baseball jersey and shorts tosses several large plastic bags into the air. One bag gets stuck on her head, causing her to laugh. The room has a simple brown door and some cardboard boxes. (4) In a hallway with cream-colored walls and maroon doors, a woman with pigtails in a white jersey performs the bag challenge with fluid, rhythmic arm movements, appearing very energetic. (5) A young woman with black hair in pigtails wearing a black jacket stands in a cluttered indoor room. She tries to manipulate the bags but looks slightly confused as they fall. (6) A young woman in a cheerleader outfit performs a deep squat while shaking plastic bags, smiling at the camera. The background includes a white table and a TV screen. (7) A woman in a black and white school-style uniform dances in a doorway with Rakuten logos, incorporating high kicks and dynamic bag movements. (8) In the same doorway, a woman in a white jersey tosses the bags high and catches them with precision, smiling. (9) A blonde woman with pigtails in a white jersey performs the challenge in the doorway, adding a playful kick and laughing. (10) A red-haired woman in a white jersey sits on a room floor, happily playing with the bags. (11) A woman in a dressing room with mirrors and jackets gets a bag caught on her head while attempting the challenge. (12) Back at the stadium track, the first woman runs playfully toward the camera, ending with a plastic bag stuck on her head while she giggles.
